description: SECURITY (s441 fix round, review:S441-f4f5-review). The fire-and-forget exemption (`setTimeout(fn)` discards fn's return, so passing an async fn is not an escape) was keyed on the callee NAME: a server function that declares its own `function setTimeout(f) { return f(hash) }` and hands it a helper wrapping scrml:auth `verifyPassword` got the exemption, and the check returned the helper's Promise — always truthy, every password accepted (reviewer-executed). Only the GLOBAL scheduler discards the return; a program-bound name is an ordinary function, and the value use fails closed.
rationale: §13.2: the fire-and-forget exemption applies only to the global scheduler; passing an async-colored function to a program-bound function named like one SHALL be E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE (§34).
